title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，将动态时序图建模为快照序列，通过图摘要压缩与图自编码器重构误差训练，结合循环神经网络学习时间依赖，实现高效的大规模时序图表示学习。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which models dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots, compresses the original graph through graph summarization and trains node representations via reconstruction error of graph autoencoder, then learns temporal dependencies with a recurrent neural network, achieving efficient representation learning on large-scale sequential graphs.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列
采用图摘要技术对原图进行压缩，将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器
利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
通过循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each moment
Compress the original graph via graph summarization and input the compressed graph into a graph autoencoder
Train node representations of the original graph using reconstruction error with the original graph
Learn feature information and dependencies of the original graph in the time dimension through a recurrent neural network
source_locations: 摘要第一段: GSAERU模型描述
论文正文: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究，第5页

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用“领导-工作者”模式，领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法划分原图并分配子图，工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练并通过注意力层返回结果，领导节点汇总结果计算梯度并同步更新模型，实现大规模图流数据下的高效分布式GNN训练。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts the "leader-worker" mode. The leader divides the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation and assigns subgraphs to workers, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization and return results through an attention layer, the leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models, achieving efficient distributed GNN training on large-scale graph streaming data.
technical_features: 采用“领导-工作者”工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分并分配子图
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: The leader divides the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation and assigns subgraphs
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
The leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes
source_locations: 摘要第二段: DSGNN模型描述

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法，用于大规模图流数据的分布式划分，通过边分割的方式对图进行划分，以适应图数据的不规则性，为分布式图神经网络训练提供有效的子图划分。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation for distributed partitioning of large-scale graph streaming data, which partitions the graph by edge segmentation to adapt to the irregularity of graph data, providing effective subgraph partitioning for distributed graph neural network training.
technical_features: 基于边分割的图流划分算法
将原图划分为多个子图
适应图数据的不规则性
technical_features_en: Graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation
Partition the original graph into multiple subgraphs
Adapt to the irregularity of graph data
source_locations: 摘要第二段: DSGNN模型描述中的划分算法
